grades.support_error: Mechanism says net or absolute adjustment units meet or exceed linked units. Receipt tests ABS(net)>=ABS(movement), but sum(abs(adjustments))>ABS(movement), not >=. Equality for the latter was not ruled out.
grades.missing_test: Trace actual measure contribution and establish the authoritative adjustment/duplicate-entry rule.
grades.selection_evidence: Six reads consumed on adjustment profiles and duplicate non-key signatures, without downstream contribution test.
grades.grading_basis: Observed receipts and full compiled query, not hidden fixture values.

grades.established: 360 unique stock movement IDs; 29 adjustment-linked groups; naive adjustment join produces 361 rows, one extra. No duplicate signatures in the tested linked population.
grades.mechanism_established_from_seen_evidence: Naive adjustment-join fanout is established; use of that join by the actual measure is not.
grades.missing_test: Establish actual measure/transform inclusion path, then compare it against an authoritative adjustment rule.
grades.selection_evidence: Five reads profiled adjustment ratios, fanout and linked duplicates; one complexity rejection, then budget stop.
grades.remaining_test_limitation: The suggested single business-rule check alone would not prove that the production measure uses the tested naive join.
